question: What word means pretending to work while actually doing nothing?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fudgel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fudgel"** means pretending to work while actually doing nothing. (काम करने का ढोंग करना जबकि वास्तव में कुछ नहीं करना)

 
 
• **Example: **John spent most of his day fudgeling at his desk, looking busy but accomplishing nothing.
 

 
• **"Fudgel" **captures the act of appearing industrious but being unproductive. (काम में व्यस्त दिखने का नाटक करना लेकिन वास्तव में निष्क्रिय होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She was caught fudgeling by her manager, pretending to work on the project but scrolling through social media instead.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Fudgel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bloviation **(लंबी-चौड़ी बातें करना): Speaking at length in an inflated or empty way.

 
 
• **Example:** The politician's bloviation during the rally irritated the audience.
 

 
• **Skookum **(मजबूत या अच्छा): A term of Chinook origin meaning strong, brave, or impressive.

 
 
• **Example: **The skookum design of the bridge has withstood many earthquakes.
 

 
• **Xanthic** (पीले रंग का): Pertaining to a yellow color or tint.

 
 
• **Example:** The xanthic hue of the sunset was mesmerizing.
